audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer chart said Katarina on all 7 rows while content win[] and packet levelChart both said Xerath on all 7, and both layers' whys describe Xerath winning every stage (melee assassin, no ranged trade, E cancels Shunpo and Death Lotus).
audit.why: packet.levelChart = Xerath x7; win[0..6] = Xerath; kit-grounded: Katarina is melee with no sustain, Death Lotus is an interruptible channel, Xerath E out-ranges Shunpo 1050 vs 725.

audit.why: Spikes sound: lane dominance 3-5, level 6 E-cancels-Death-Lotus, Luden's denial, late reset threat in teamfights — all present in spikes[] and late text.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digits; interactions otherwise well covered (E cancels Shunpo mid-blink and the Death Lotus channel; Kat Q grounding note: her Q is a dagger, the grounding flag on it contradicts Riot's text — trust the text, it does not ground).
audit.why: Katarina E cd 12/11/10/9/8, range 725; R cd 75/60/45, an interruptible channel that applies anti-heal; Voracity resets on kills.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns rewritten with real numbers; bleed bullets replaced with Shunpo-range and reset-train facts.
